evidenceLevels.official: Current hero, identity API, client direct spells and the formal February 2023 release agree. The announcement was published 2023-02-17 and sale begins 2023-02-18 00:30.
evidenceLevels.supplementary: No located current same-product FAQ settles the entity lifetime, special ownership zones, leave-and-return, insertion order or exchange-slot permutation questions below. No other-product Liu Ba rules are imported.
evidenceLevels.inference: The following implementation interpretations follow the complete current wording and native physical movement boundaries. They are not asserted as official FAQ rulings.

implementationInterpretations: Tongdu permits the owner or another living Hand holder. The chosen holder privately selects one original Hand entity. Self-gift records a successful semantic no-op, never a fake movement between the same zone.

An issued gift debt belongs to its original source instance and actual turn, survives subsequent source loss, and is consumed at the first genuine PlayEnding in that turn, including a real inserted Play. Skipped Play does not create an ending; a debt never migrates into a later actual turn.

The original entity may be topdecked only if it is currently in the original recipient’s ordinary owned Hand, Equipment, Judgment or Wooden Ox grain zone. A card used or transferred elsewhere is not reclaimed. If the exact entity genuinely returns before the due phase, its current owned entity may be returned. General Weapon removal restrictions are preserved.

Zhubi uses the current maximum HP against the native skill/group actual-Play counter. A same-phase maximum change does not reset past expenditures. Each target privately chooses a true HE entity; recast is not logical discard and does not borrow discardability eligibility.

Recast pays one actual physical entity, inherits General Weapon OutsideGame, Silver Lion recovery and Wooden Ox grain removal, then rewards Draw1 after native children. Only an exact original DrawPile-to-recipient-Hand RecastDraw entity returned by that reward is minted. A reshuffle, incidental child gain or reward zero is not a coin.

A coin is a permanent physical-ID label because the current text provides no unmark or expiry. Transfer, use, discard, deck recycling, original source loss and original source death do not remove that label. A second mint does not duplicate an already marked entity.

Current ordinary ownership for held/payment coins is HEJ and Wooden Ox grain. Other mechanisms’ exclusive public/private persistent piles are not silently treated as freely spendable cards. Equipped General Weapons are excluded from equal deck exchange because native removal sends them OutsideGame. These zone choices are explicit engine interpretations pending a specific same-product FAQ.

A minted coin confers its holder’s issued Ending view/exchange entitlement independently of possession of the original Zhubi skill. A holder’s death before payment cancels the unpaid request; fully committed movements and their children still return once.

The holder privately views the actual available bottom min(5,count) in place. Viewing neither moves, publicly reveals, draws nor reshuffles. The holder may select zero or any legal number of distinct coins and equal distinct viewed bottom entities.

Both selected sets commit in one native atomic batch before equipment removal hooks. The i-th outgoing coin replaces the i-th selected bottom entity in its original deck slot. Every unselected slot and all other current deck order are preserved. This deterministic pairing is an explicit order inference, not a published FAQ.
Unmarked obtained bottom cards do not automatically become coins; previously marked physical bottom cards keep their existing mark. Exchange contains no textual unmark instruction.

Pending choices, original materials, viewed bottom identities and exact payment/return proof live only on the owning ProgramSkillFrame. Public facts are scalar, exposed receipt collections are defensively frozen, and only the actual active holder receives bottom faces through its private snapshot.
